title: fix: allow API key expiries beyond 365 days
author: Architjain128
pr_body_excerpt:
Fixes #15559

- Removes the 365-day cap from both key-creation APIs and Better Auth.
- Keeps the contributor’s readable error handling for invalid key requests.
- Validates that an expiry fits the supported date range; leaving it blank still means no expiry.

Verified: 366-day key integration test, Enter typecheck, Biome.

gist.headline: Keys with longer shelf lives
gist.blurb: API keys can now have an expiry more than 365 days away. Leave the expiry blank and they’ll keep their no-expiry setting.
gist.summary: Removed the 365-day expiry cap from both API-key creation routes and Better Auth, while validating dates against the supported range and preserving readable errors for invalid requests.
gist.impact: Users can create keys that expire after 366 days or more, or leave the expiry blank for a key with no expiry.
